sourceSection:
# 4. POSTECH

## A. University snapshot

| Field | Verified answer |
|---|---|
| University | Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH) |
| Country / city / campus | Republic of Korea · Pohang · residential main campus |
| University type | Private STEM institute |
| Fall 2027 status | **PARTIALLY CONFIRMED / guide TBA** |
| Application platform | Expected: **Study in Korea**, but Fall 2027 portal link is not yet published |
| Application URL | [Official international undergraduate admissions](https://adm-iu.postech.ac.kr/user/comm/menu/3317587a17a23d4dacdb9ffc4762bf4a/content/index.do) |
| Best programme(s) | Mueunjae School (undeclared) → **Computer Science & Engineering**; secondary Electrical Engineering |
| Degree / language | Bachelor’s; POSTECH states an all-English curriculum for international undergraduate entrants from Fall 2026 |
| Major structure | Freshmen enter Mueunjae School; major exploration precedes selection, normally before the fourth semester |
| Approximate international intake / selectivity | Not officially published for Fall 2027 |

## Changes since 13 Sep 2026

- **No Fall 2027 guide yet.** The official page still gives only an expected **March–April 2027** application and a guide expected in **late January 2027**.
- Current FAQ confirms that scores arriving after the deadline are not considered, the application fee is non-refundable and has no waiver, and an English-medium letter must cover the entire high-school curriculum.
- Current housing page was updated 15 September 2026 with Spring 2026 rates; first-year students live in Residential College.
- Do not copy the Spring 2027 cycle or Fall 2026 dates into Fall 2027.

## B. Programmes for this applicant

| Official programme | Degree / unit | Entry and prerequisites | Restrictions / change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Computer Science & Engineering | Bachelor’s department after Mueunjae exploration | No separate international CSE admission standard published. Current first-year placement subjects include calculus, physics, chemistry and programming/problem solving. | No standalone undergraduate AI degree identified; CSE curriculum covers programming, algorithms, systems, AI/ML and data-related study. |
| Electrical Engineering | Bachelor’s department | General STEM admission; strong Math/Physics preparation useful | Logical computer-engineering/hardware alternative |

**Best programme for me:** CSE. It is the cleanest route to software, AI and data science. EE is appropriate only if the applicant wants hardware, circuits, signals or embedded systems. POSTECH’s international admission is to the freshman unit, so the final Fall 2027 guide must confirm the exact declaration timetable and any capacity rules.

## C. Application rounds and deadlines

| Event | Fall 2027 date | Confirmed? | What must be ready |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Guide publication | Late Jan 2027 expected | Partial | Recheck exact forms, fee, essays, recs, document authentication |
| Application opens | TBA; March–April window expected | Partial | Study in Korea profile, school/test documents |
| Application closes | TBA | No | Complete application and official scores must arrive |
| Documents / recommendations | TBA | No | Guide controls |
| Interview | Current FAQ says not required for the International Admissions Track; Fall 2027 guide controls | Partial | None unless policy changes |
| Decision / acceptance / deposit | TBA | No | Offer-specific |
| Final diploma / apostille / housing / visa | TBA | No | After admission |

**PREVIOUS CYCLE REFERENCE only:** Fall 2026 applications ran 26 Sep–3 Nov 2025 with decision 5 Jan 2026 through Study in Korea. These are not Fall 2027 dates.

### My recommended timeline

- By **1 December 2026:** collect Grade 10–12/current transcript, NIS school profile, expected-graduation letter, identity/family documents and an English-medium letter even if also taking IELTS.
- By **10 January 2027:** choose Math/CS/Physics recommender and prepare a reusable factual résumé/project evidence.
- From **20 January:** check the official notice twice weekly.
- Within **48 hours of guide release:** map every new form, essay and score-delivery rule.
- Target submission: **10 days before the official deadline**; order all official score reports at least 2–3 weeks before the deadline.

## D. Platform and fee

| Item | Fall 2027 answer |
|---|---|
| Platform | TBA; Study in Korea was used in the last official Fall cycle |
| Can create 2027 application now? | No published Fall 2027 form |
| Programme choices / edits / grade updates | TBA |
| Fee | **TBA** |
| Refund / waiver | Official FAQ: fee is non-refundable and no waiver is offered; exact 2027 amount TBA |
| Scholarship fee | None published |
| Paper mail | Initial process TBA. Authenticated final records are expected under current FAQ/past guide practice. |

## E. Document checklist

Because the Fall 2027 guide is not published, every row below is either a current official FAQ rule or **PREVIOUS CYCLE REFERENCE** and must be revalidated in January.

| Document | Status for Fall 2027 | Who / format | Current best evidence |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Online application | TBA | Applicant, likely Study in Korea | Portal not open |
| Passport | Expected, unconfirmed | Applicant upload | Previous cycle |
| Parents’ passports / citizenship | Expected, unconfirmed | Applicant upload | Previous cycle |
| Family relationship / birth certificate | Expected, unconfirmed | Applicant upload | Previous cycle |
| Full high-school transcript | Expected | Applicant/school official scan; authenticated version later | FAQ says submit the official complete national school record |
| Expected graduation / final diploma | Expected | School-issued; apostille/Korean consular authentication under current FAQ | Exact 2027 timing TBA |
| NIS school profile / grading explanation | REC | School/applicant | Needed to explain a country-specific curriculum |
| English test or MOI | TBA | Agency/school | Current FAQ: MOI must state entire HS curriculum was in English; exemption decided after review |
| SAT/ACT/IB/AP/A-level/national exam | TBA | Official agency by deadline where applicable | Late scores are not considered; PDF does not replace official report |
| Recommendation | TBA | Recommender | Previous cycle required one; do not assume for 2027 |
| Personal statement / study plan | TBA | Applicant | Previous cycle used these; exact prompts/limits unavailable |
| Awards / activities / school profile | TBA | Applicant | Previous cycle reference |
| CV, GitHub, portfolio | Not officially required yet | — | Use only if the new form allows |
| Final apostilled records | Expected after admission | Applicant/school/courier | Country-specific FAQ confirms authentication expectation |

## F. NIS route

- POSTECH has not published a named NIS route, NIS HL-subject requirement or minimum NIS score.
- Current FAQ says applicants from different school systems must submit the official complete secondary-school records and an explanation where the format differs.
- Ask NIS for a school profile, grading scale, current transcript and an official expected-graduation letter. Predicted NIS treatment remains **TBA**.
- The current FAQ allows a school-issued MOI letter for English exemption review, but the letter must confirm that the **entire** high-school curriculum was taught in English. Exemption is not automatic.
- June final-certificate and apostille timing cannot be assessed until the Fall 2027 guide publishes the final-document deadline.

## G. Academic tests and English

### Official minimum for Fall 2027

**Not officially published.** No current-cycle GPA, NIS, SAT, IELTS or subject minimum may be stated.

### Competitive target — analysis

POSTECH is an extreme-reach STEM institution. Strong Math, Physics/CS coursework and externally verifiable quantitative achievement matter. No official competitive SAT/IELTS range is published. SAT 1300–1350 would not make this a safe or match application.

| Item | Current verified rule | Fall 2027 status |
|---|---|---|
| SAT/ACT/AP/IB/A-level | Current FAQ requires official reports where applicable and rejects post-deadline arrivals | Requirement/optional status TBA |
| Superscore / self-report | Not officially published for Fall 2027 | TBA |
| IELTS/TOEFL/other English tests | Exact accepted list and minimum TBA | TBA |
| MOI waiver | Whole curriculum in English; school letterhead/seal/contact; reviewed case by case | Current FAQ, but guide controls |
| Late reports | Not considered; documented provider delay may receive case-by-case review | Current FAQ |
| Internal English placement | After enrolment, students take/receive English placement level | Not an admission substitute |

## H. Internal exam, interview and recommendations

- Current FAQ says an admission interview is **not required** for the current International Admissions Track; the unreleased Fall 2027 guide remains controlling.
- No current-cycle Math/Physics/programming admissions exam is published.
- Recommendation number, recommender role, form, exact rating categories and deadline are all **TBA**.

**Recommendation strategy:** reserve one detailed Math/CS/Physics teacher now, but do not send anything until the 2027 form appears. A counselor should separately prepare NIS curriculum and grading context.

## I. Essays

| Essay | Fall 2027 prompt | Limit | Status |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Personal statement | TBA | TBA | Previous cycle used a statement; no 2027 prompt |
| Study plan / Why POSTECH-major | TBA | TBA | Previous cycle reference only |
| Scholarship essay | None currently published | — | TBA |

Possible themes can be prepared—technical curiosity, project decisions, research potential, collaboration and fit—but no text should be drafted to an invented prompt.

## J. Scholarships and aid

| Category | Award / rule | Separate application? | Status |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Automatic tuition | International Admissions I tuition scholarship | No | Current policy: first semester full tuition; up to eight regular semesters if prior GPA ≥3.0/4.3 from second semester |
| Living support | International undergraduate allowance | No separate form stated | KRW 500,000/month, including vacations; current page says no GPA condition |
| Arrival support | One-way economy airfare + domestic transport | Claim/reimbursement process | Actual cost up to KRW 2.5m; for eligible new international students who did not reside in Korea in preceding six months |
| Pathfinder voucher | Educational voucher | Programme approval | KRW 10m over four years, normally KRW 2.5m/year after three semesters; approved activities/devices, not cash living stipend |
| TOPIK award | One-time | Evidence | KRW 300k for TOPIK 4 under current policy |
| Need-based aid | No separate international undergraduate need-based scheme identified | — | Not officially published |

Source: [official scholarship page](https://adm-iu.postech.ac.kr/user/comm/menu/e2afb97fa1b8f43c574be0dabef78f87/content/index.do).

### Coverage, renewal and real gap

| Cost | Covered? | Current rule |
|---|---:|---|
| Tuition | Yes, conditional after first term | Full first term; continued to 8 semesters with GPA ≥3.0/4.3 |
| Housing / meals | No direct waiver stated | Paid from stipend/personal funds |
| Stipend | Yes | KRW 500k/month |
| Flight | Yes, conditional reimbursement | Up to KRW 2.5m once |
| Books / laptop | Pathfinder may fund approved study use | Not general cash |
| Insurance / visa / local transport | Not confirmed as scholarship coverage | TBA |

An exact annual gap cannot be calculated until Fall 2027 tuition/fees and award terms are in the guide. Current dormitory rates effective Spring 2026 are KRW 149k–175k per four weeks for undergraduate double rooms; first-year students reside in Residential College. Housing is not shown as paid by the scholarship. [Official dormitory page](https://www.postech.ac.kr/eng/student-life/dormitory.do) The page does not itself promise all four years; a separate exchange factsheet’s guarantee should not be generalized to degree students.

## K. After admission

All dates are TBA. Expected tasks: accept offer; pay any deposit; submit final NIS diploma/transcript with apostille or Korean consular authentication; verify test reports; arrange D-2 visa, insurance and Residential College housing; complete placement/orientation. The 2027 offer and guide control.

## L. Strategic assessment — analysis

- **Admission difficulty:** Extreme reach.
- **Full-funding difficulty:** Extreme reach at admission stage; current package is strong once admitted, but tuition renewal requires GPA 3.0/4.3.
- **Fit:** Excellent for a research-oriented CS applicant; lack of current prompts means preparation should focus on evidence, not speculative essays.

## M. Still TBA / needs confirmation

Exact dates, portal, fee amount, programme-choice count, eligibility, all required documents, predicted-grade rule, tests and minimums, official score codes, recommendation form, essays/limits, decision/deposit/final-document dates, Fall 2027 tuition and housing allocation, and whether any current scholarship term changes.

## N. Email question

> I am an NIS Grade 12 applicant from Kazakhstan and will receive my final NIS Certificate in June 2027. For Fall 2027, will POSTECH accept official NIS predicted grades and an expected-graduation letter at application, with the final apostilled certificate after admission? Please also confirm whether an NIS letter stating that the entire high-school curriculum is taught in English can qualify for English-test exemption, and the final deadline for authenticated records.
